prompt:
Reception: Good evening, front desk. How can I help?
Katja: Hello! Can I (speak / talk) to someone about my window? The lock is stuck open, and a neighbour's cat keeps trying to jump onto my bed.
Reception: Oh no! Let me (tell / say) the night worker right away, and he will come up to fix it.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске для телефонного разговора подходят глаголы speak и talk с предлогом to. Во втором пропуске глагол tell используется с прямым дополнением (the night worker) без предлога to.

prompt:
Bram: Did you see that arrow by the lift? Whoever put up these signs clearly didn't (say / tell) what floor the main hall is on.
Lotte: True, and people always (talk / speak) about how confusing this building is. Even worse, my dress shoes are so loud on this marble floor that everyone turns around whenever we (say / speak) a word.
explanation_ru: Глагол say вводит придаточное предложение (what floor...) без указания адресата. Для обсуждения темы (about...) подходят talk и speak. В устойчивом выражении say a word («сказать хоть слово») используется только глагол say.

prompt:
Workshop: Music Repair Shop, how may I help?
Otto: Hi, I need to (speak / talk) with a repair worker right now. My violin bow just broke behind the curtain, and my concert starts in twenty minutes!
Workshop: Stay calm and (tell / say) me your exact address so our driver can bring a spare bow right away.
explanation_ru: С предлогом with при просьбе позвать кого-то к телефону используются speak и talk. Во втором пропуске глагол tell требует прямого дополнения (me) перед косвенным (your exact address).

prompt:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nordic Home. How can I assist you?
Jonas: Hello, I'm calling because I don't (speak / talk) Danish, yet my flat-pack bookshelf came with two Danish manuals and zero wooden pegs. Could you (tell / say) me how to get English instructions and the missing parts?
Agent: Of course, I'll (say / tell) our warehouse team to dispatch a replacement kit today.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения владения иностранным языком используется только глагол speak. В конструкциях tell + лицо + вопросительное слово/инфинитив (tell me how..., tell our team to...) требуется глагол tell.

prompt:
Laundry: FreshPress Cleaners, good afternoon.
Ronan: Hi, please (tell / say) me this is a mix-up! We just opened our team bag before the match, and instead of our green jerseys, it's packed with bright pink hockey vests. I honestly don't know what to (say / tell) to the coach.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске глагол tell используется с прямым дополнением (me). Во втором пропуске после what употребляется say, так как адресат вводится через предлог to (to the coach).

prompt:
Dispatch: City Bike Rescue, where are you calling from?
Jonas: I'm sheltering under a bakery awning halfway up Hill Street. My rear chain snapped cleanly while I was pedalling toward the station, so could you (tell / say) the driver to look for the green shopfront? I'll (speak / talk) to him as soon as the van pulls up.
explanation_ru: В конструкции «попросить/велеть кому-то сделать что-то» (tell the driver to look) используется глагол tell. Для обозначения разговора с человеком (to him) подходят как speak, так и talk.

prompt:
Office: Airport Shuttle Desk, how can I help?
Tarek: Hello, your red minibus just drove straight past the terminal doors while I was tying my bootlace! Didn't the schedule (say / tell) the bus waits until quarter past? Please (tell / say) the driver to circle back.
explanation_ru: О письменном тексте или расписании («в расписании говорится, что...») употребляется глагол say. В конструкции с инфинитивом и указанием адресата (tell the driver to circle back) используется tell.

prompt:
Secretary: Geography Department, good morning.
Joris: Hi, I'm standing outside in the pouring rain because my student badge suddenly stopped unlocking the map room. My oral exam starts in ten minutes, so could you (tell / say) the examiner I'll be two minutes late? I'd also like to (speak / talk) to someone about resetting my card.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу следует адресат (the examiner) без предлога. В значении «поговорить с кем-либо» перед предлогом to одинаково естественны speak и talk.

prompt:
Banker: Business Bank, can you hear me clearly?
Heidi: Hardly—train bells are ringing loudly right below my window every twenty seconds, so I have to (speak / talk) loudly. Could you (tell / say) me why our morning payment is still waiting?
explanation_ru: Для описания манеры речи или громкости голоса (loudly) подходят speak и talk. В вопросе «не могли бы вы сказать мне, почему...» (tell me why...) требуется tell с прямым дополнением.

prompt: Yoko and Stefan barely (speak / talk) twenty words of English between them, yet they get along wonderfully at the mountain hostel. Over tea, they happily (talk / speak) about their favourite soup recipes and draw hiking boots on paper napkins to (tell / say) each other which trails are easiest.
explanation_ru: С названиями языков и количеством слов на языке используется speak. Для беседы на тему (about...) подходят talk и speak. В конструкции «сообщить друг другу, какие...» (tell each other which...) нужен глагол tell.

prompt: While the brass quintet warms up on stage, Ximena and Bruno sit on the lawn and (talk / speak) softly about the cool evening breeze. Bruno laughs and (says / tells) that the crickets sing louder than the trumpets during every quiet solo.
explanation_ru: Для непринужденной беседы на какую-либо тему (about...) подходят talk и speak. Во втором пропуске глагол say вводит придаточное предложение с союзом that без указания слушателя.

prompt: Waiting for the slow screen machine to load, Kofi and Muna (talk / speak) about how late holiday post deliveries have become. Muna (says / tells) Kofi that she has been trying all week to find a strong umbrella that won't turn inside out in the wind.
explanation_ru: Для общения на общую тему (about...) используются talk и speak. Во втором пропуске после глагола сразу указан адресат (Kofi) без предлога to, поэтому выбираем tells.

prompt: Catching their breath in the cool mountain air, Paloma and Fabian (talk / speak) about the steep, muddy switchbacks they just climbed. Paloma (says / tells) that the fruit stalls near the finish line sell the sweetest cold melon slices in the valley.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске глаголы talk и speak оба сочетаются с предлогом about при обсуждении темы. Во втором пропуске глагол say вводит придаточное с that без прямого дополнения.

prompt: Waiting at the stop in the salty sea mist, Ewan and Niamh ___ about the slippery pavements and why the number twelve bus always seems to arrive in pairs.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения беседы на определенную тему с предлогом about используется глагол talk (talk about something). Глаголы say и tell не употребляются в такой конструкции, а speak to требует указания собеседника.

prompt: Sitting by the only free power point near the gate, Eleni and Boris ___ about their thick warm sweaters, the cold rain outside, and the bad airport sandwiches.
explanation_ru: Глагол talk естественно сочетается с предлогом about (talk about something — разговаривать о чем-либо). Глаголы say и tell в этом значении не используются.

prompt: Waiting for their hot chocolate during a study break, Olli ___ Maren that his bike lock froze shut this morning and the chairs in room four make a loud noise every time someone moves.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу идет прямое дополнение, обозначающее адресата (Maren), без предлога to. Глагол say в такой позиции потребовал бы предлога to (says to Maren).

prompt: Shaking off their wet umbrellas in the hall, Wendy says Declan that the streets are covered in ice and asks whether the hotel cafe still sells warm sweet rolls.
answer: Shaking off their wet umbrellas in the hall, Wendy tells Declan that the streets are covered in ice and asks whether the hotel cafe still sells warm sweet rolls.
accepted_answers: Shaking off their wet umbrellas in the hall, Wendy tells Declan that the streets are covered in ice and asks whether the hotel cafe still sells warm sweet rolls.
Shaking off their wet umbrellas in the hall, Wendy says to Declan that the streets are covered in ice and asks whether the hotel cafe still sells warm sweet rolls.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не используется напрямую с одушевленным дополнением без предлога to. Правильно: tells Declan или says to Declan.

prompt: Sitting on the warm wooden bench in the lodge, Laszlo and Neve talk about the fresh powder snow and laugh about how impossible it is to walk gracefully in ski boots.
answer: Sitting on the warm wooden bench in the lodge, Laszlo and Neve talk about the fresh powder snow and laugh about how impossible it is to walk gracefully in ski boots.
accepted_answers: Sitting on the warm wooden bench in the lodge, Laszlo and Neve talk about the fresh powder snow and laugh about how impossible it is to walk gracefully in ski boots.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: сочетание talk about (разговаривать о чем-либо) употреблено грамматически верно.

prompt: In her short thank-you note to the print clerk, Eva tells a warm thank you for staying ten minutes past closing to bind her final paper before the deadline.
answer: In her short thank-you note to the print clerk, Eva says a warm thank you for staying ten minutes past closing to bind her final paper before the deadline.
accepted_answers: In her short thank-you note to the print clerk, Eva says a warm thank you for staying ten minutes past closing to bind her final paper before the deadline.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении «сказать спасибо» (say thank you) используется глагол say, а не tell.
